# PomoFocus Workspace

> PomoFocus is a Zen-first, privacy-focused productivity and deep-work platform combining atomic Pomodoro timers, Web Audio ambient soundscapes, WebRTC live study rooms, and an AI study companion.

## Core Features
- Pomodoro Timer: Microsecond-precision countdowns, multi-tab synchronization via BroadcastChannel, Web Worker background lifecycle.
- Ambient Soundscapes: 101 high-definition scenery backgrounds and spatial ambient sound generator with independent playback.
- Live Study Rooms: WebRTC full-mesh peer-to-peer virtual study rooms with host governance and privacy controls.
- AI Companion: Socratic tutoring, LaTeX mathematical parsing, and note insertion.
